name: svg-forge
description: Design animated SVGs that render everywhere: self-contained README cards, banners, headings, stats and streak cards, loaders, icons and diagrams, plus React and Motion scenes for web apps. Three skills, a designer subagent, a stdlib generator for 23 kinds at any size with desktop and phone layouts and 15 contrast-checked themes or a brand color, starter packs for a whole README, a validator with WCAG contrast rules, a frame renderer and a safe minifier.
